I registered the miss as [entry 78](docs/rule-failures.md) and pushed it. I drafted the amendment through `/skill-up` and tried it on two fresh judges.

**What the judges found:**
- **First judge.** The new occasion fired: it loaded `/product` and read `docs/product.md` before answering. But my clause nearly copied `/discover`'s trigger, so the two read as rivals, and the body gave that occasion no instruction.
- **Second judge,** on the revision. "By its own account" sets the two apart as complements, the inside account and the outside view. The new goal could be acted on, except that it never said to read the document. I've added that to the text below.

The change removes nothing and adds about 45 words to a 308-word body.

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/skills/product/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/product/SKILL.md) · description**

> Keep the project's product document — the pains it relieves, its goals, the causes and the answers — and see how much of each answer is built. Use when a decision about what the project is for lands as an answer, when writing or reading the product document, when about to say what the project is or what sets it apart by its own account, or when asked which answers are built, being built, or not started, or what each queued ticket builds and which answers no ticket does.

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/skills/product/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/product/SKILL.md) · Goals**

> 5. **Tell the project from it.** Before saying what the project is or what sets it apart, read the
>    document; tell it by the pains it relieves and the answers it gives, never by its mechanisms.

✏️ **Proposed change — [.agents/mechanisms/product/product.md](.agents/mechanisms/product/product.md) · Moments**

> | saying what the project is, or what sets it apart, by its own account | `.agents/skills/product/SKILL.md` | |

The first judge also named older faults in the description: it describes the document's format, and it gives linking a question to its answer and `--check` no trigger. They lie outside this miss, so I've left them.

✋ Land the amendment to `/product` as shown (🐛 self-improvement=a rule)

bounds.source_evidence: Public native fields and relevant instruction snapshots are preserved; private thinking and unrelated memory are excluded.
bounds.validation: Portable occurrence evidence and explicit replay boundary; dated validation records distinguish source gaps from executor support. No instruction-effect result or current-runner compatibility is claimed.

preloaded native tool calls and their matched results where present

limits: The retained prefix is a selection of public source records, not a claim to reconstruct private reasoning or hidden provider state.
